completed_batches.module: Customer Account Claiming / Customer Record Linking
completed_batches.fix: Hardened staged RLS migration without applying it to production.
details: Internal access now checks both profiles and admin_profiles.
Allowed active internal roles include super_admin, admin, operations_admin, support_admin, support, finance_admin and finance.
Customer read access now supports customers.auth_user_id, customers.claimed_auth_user_id and customers.profile_id -> profiles.auth_user_id.

completed_batches.fix: Added reusable status_transition_logs helper and connected public service request creation to service_request_lifecycle logging.
details: Public repair request creation now attempts a real status_transition_logs insert for object_type=service_request, from_status=null, to_status=pending_review.
Audit log records the actual status_transition_logged boolean instead of assuming success.

completed_batches.fix: Aligned full-chain read API and existing V28.4.5 verifier with production Supabase schema.
details: Full-chain quotations now use service_request_id/customer_id/version/total_amount/status instead of deprecated job_id/current_version/total/approval_status fields.
Full-chain invoices now use total_amount and quotation_id instead of total.
Full-chain payments no longer select fee or payment_url fields that do not exist in production.
Full-chain warranties now use starts_on/ends_on and production-visible linkage fields.
Verifier now blocks the deprecated selectors from returning.

completed_batches.fix: Aligned live-core GET/POST/PATCH schema with production fields and added status_transition_logs writes for admin-created records and update-based status changes.
details: Live Core quotation fields now use service_request_id/customer_id/version/total_amount/currency/status instead of job_id/current_version/total/approval_status.
Live Core invoice fields now use total_amount/currency/visible_to_customer and no longer use total.
Live Core payment fields no longer use fee/payment_url/visible_to_customer and use amount/currency/status/reconciled_at.
Live Core warranty fields now use starts_on/ends_on and production-visible linkage keys.
POST create now writes status_transition_logs when a created record has a status.
PATCH action=update now writes status_transition_logs when the record status actually changes. PATCH transition continues using transition_status_tx RPC.
